title: Content Repurposing Engine
description: You've created one piece of substantial content and want to extract maximum distribution from it.
prompt:
Act as a content distribution strategist. I just created:
[describe the piece - e.g., a 40-minute podcast episode / a 3,000-word
report / a 45-minute webinar recording]

Topic: [the subject matter]
Key insights from it:
- [insight 1]
- [insight 2]
- [insight 3]

Target audience: [who this was for]
Channels I publish on: [LinkedIn / email / Twitter / YouTube / blog]

Generate a repurposing plan:
1. LinkedIn post - the most surprising or counterintuitive point,
   told as a story (not a listicle), under 200 words
2. Email newsletter intro - the hook that makes subscribers click
   through to the full piece
3. Three tweet-length insights (under 280 chars each, no hashtags)
4. One Reddit-style comment for a relevant community - purely useful,
   zero self-promotion, naturally references the insight
5. One short-form video script hook (under 30 seconds) that creates
   enough tension to watch the full version
useCase: You've created one piece of substantial content and want to extract maximum distribution from it.

title: The Learning Accelerator
description: Creates a focused 30-day self-study plan for any professional skill with resources, milestones, and daily actions
prompt:
Create a 30-day self-study plan to help me get competent at [skill or topic].

My context:
- Current level: [complete beginner / some exposure / intermediate]
- Time I can commit daily: [e.g. 30 minutes / 1 hour]
- How I learn best: [reading / video / doing / teaching others]
- Why I need this skill: [career goal or specific use case]

Structure the plan as:
- Week 1: Foundation (what to learn first and why)
- Week 2: Application (how to start using it, not just studying it)
- Week 3: Depth (go harder on the specific area most relevant to me)
- Week 4: Output (create something real with what you've learned)

For each week: 3-4 specific resources or actions, and one milestone to hit by Friday.
useCase: Replacing aimless YouTube rabbit holes with a structured, outcome-focused learning plan that actually produces a usable skill in 30 days.
variables: career goal or specific use case

title: The YouTube Hook & Script Builder
description: Writes a high-retention YouTube video script starting with an unskippable hook and structured for maximum watch time
prompt:
Write a YouTube video script for the following topic:

Topic: [topic]
Target Audience: [audience]
Core Value Proposition (Why watch?): [value prop]
Creator Tone: [tone]
Target Length: [length]

Structure the script as follows:
1. The Hook (0:00 - 0:30): Use the 'Curiosity + Payoff' framework. DO NOT start with 'Hey guys, welcome back'. Create an open loop immediately.
2. The Intro/Context (0:30 - 1:00): Establish authority and exactly what they will learn.
3. Main Content Sections: Break into 3-4 distinct visual chapters.
4. Retention Spikes: Suggest B-roll, on-screen text, or pattern interrupts every 45-60 seconds.
5. The Outro: End abruptly with a CTA to another specific video (no long goodbyes).

Format the script with two columns (or clearly separated sections): [VISUAL] (what is on screen) and [AUDIO] (what is spoken).
useCase: Structuring video content to fight viewer drop-off by front-loading value and scripting intentional visual pacing.
exampleOutput: [VISUAL] Fast zoom on the creator holding a smashed iPhone. [AUDIO] 'This mistake just cost me $1,000. And if you have an iPhone 14, you are probably making it right now.' [VISUAL] Cut to clean desk setup. [AUDIO] 'Here is how to fix the battery drain issue in 30 seconds...'
